(deftype ChunkBuffer [^:mutable buf ^:mutable end]
  Object
  (add [_ o]
    (let [a buf i end]
      (set! end (inc end))
      (aset a i o)
      nil))

  (chunk [_]
    (let [ret (ArrayChunk. buf 0 end)]
      (set! buf nil)
      ret))

  ICounted
  (-count [_] end))
rationale: Preserve both mutable fields, chunk storage publication/clearing and ICounted. Adapt add to JVM Clojure 1.12.6 ChunkBuffer behavior: read buffer/index, advance end before the store (including failed bounds/null stores), and return nil after success. Executed JVM/Suss probes establish the return/effect-order differences; ClojureScript is the licensed implementation reference, not the behavior oracle.
